concepts.def: Compromise establishing Protestant Church of England with Elizabeth as Supreme Governor; Act of Uniformity required attendance.
Catholic claimant imprisoned 1568-87; executed after Babington Plot exposed Catholic conspiracy against Elizabeth.
Philip II's invasion fleet of 130 ships defeated by English ships and storms; symbolic Protestant victory.
Privateer who circumnavigated globe 1577-80 and raided Spanish ports; vice-admiral against the Armada.
System distinguishing 'deserving' from 'idle' poor; parishes raised rates to provide work or relief.
Open-air playhouse built by Shakespeare's company in Southwark; held up to 3,000 spectators.
